welcome: Good morning. My name is Sarah, and I will be your examiner today. This is the IELTS Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself and some familiar topics.
part2Intro: Thank you. Now, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic.
part2Start: All right? Remember, you have one to two minutes for this, so don't worry if I stop you. I'll tell you when the time is up. Can you start speaking now, please?
part3Intro: We've been talking about this topic, and now I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to it.
end: Thank you. That is the end of the Speaking test.
